# HBox { #anylumino.HBox }

```python
HBox(widgets=None, **kwargs)
```

Horizontal ``BoxPanel`` convenience wrapper.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                | Description                                                                            | Default   |
|----------|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| widgets  | iterable or mapping | Child widgets or keyed child mapping.                                                  | `None`    |
| **kwargs | Any                 | Forwarded to ``BoxPanel`` except ``direction``, which is fixed to ``"left-to-right"``. | `{}`      |
